about: M67.2b checked source edits. page is the raw page body; after is exact body bytes. Shape errors have no suffix; planned refusals end Nothing was written. Values normalize CR/CRLF to LF; only touched fences canonicalize CSV. A header-like lone --- row is quoted. Report cases below run through the real Rust and wasm engines.
